rationale: The write-up never names the source paper or author; it only hints at "prior stance steering" requiring benchmark items, framing its two contributions (data-free recipe, generalisation to concealment) as novel relative to that unnamed prior work. The closing message explicitly names "Raman et al." and the "white-bear" mechanism, states the method reproduces it using the benchmark's own `directed_modulation` items, and additionally attributes the exclusion of secret/preference items to "the original paper" — details and an explicit credit the write-up withholds.
